newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's real drops 0.04 pct on lower mini-band.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's real drops 0.04 pct on lower mini-band.

text.p: Brazil's real dropped 0.04 percent to close at 1.0820 per dollar in listless trade in the commercial forex market after the Central Bank lowered the reais-dollar mini-band, dealers said.
The Central Bank depreciated the mini-band Friday for the fifth time this month, lowering it 0.09 percent to between 1.0820 and 1.0870 reais per dollar via a buy/sell auction.
The previous mini-band was set July 17 at between 1.0810 and 1.0860 per greenback.
So far this month, the mini-band has fallen 0.51 percent against the dollar compared to monthly declines of between 0.57 and 0.61 percent in the past six months.
The Central Bank bought dollars at 1.0820 per greenback to drain excess dollars from the market in late afternoon, dealers said.
In the interbank floating rate market, the real dropped 0.03 percent to end at 1.0877 per dollar. In the parallel market, the real closed unchanged at 1.148 per dollar, traders said.
